name: production-durable-storage
title: Configure production durable storage
description: Connect the Render production service to the existing Supabase Storage S3 bucket for durable session artifacts.
scope: Supabase Storage S3 credentials and Render production environment
creator: lenovo
notes: Do not commit S3 credentials. Supabase PAT can manage storage config and buckets but cannot create hosted S3 access keys; that endpoint requires a Dashboard login JWT.

blocker.required: Supabase Dashboard-generated S3 access key pair
